summary: Full backend + frontend test pass for FestyVille prototype. 15/15 pytest backend tests passing (catalog 16 items, grid 8, default state defaults, place/speedup/simulate/demolish/rename/leaderboard, 400 errors for occupied/oob/locked/no-coins). Frontend mobile UI flows all working (HUD, isometric grid taps, BuildDrawer, place→timer, speedup, RUN FESTIVAL→simulation modal w/ grade + 5 dim bars + rewards, leaderboard navigation + rename). Found and fixed 1 critical interaction bug: IsometricGrid tiles were using onTouchEnd on a plain View, which on react-native-web does NOT fire on mouse clicks, so desktop/web users could not place buildings. Replaced with Pressable+onPress, which handles both touch and click.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. Was using onTouchEnd on a plain View, which on react-native-web does not fire for mouse clicks — placement was impossible on desktop/web. Replaced with Pressable+onPress (works for both touch and click).

issues: Multiple expo-warn console messages: 'shadow*' style props deprecated -> use 'boxShadow', 'textShadow*' -> 'textShadow'. Non-blocking but should be migrated (HUD pills, runBtn). Cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo CLI warns @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 (expected 2.2.0) and react-native-svg@15.15.5 (expected 15.12.1). App runs fine but may cause warnings/issues on native builds.

action_items: (optional) Migrate shadow*/textShadow* deprecated style props to boxShadow/textShadow in HUD.tsx, ConstructionTimer.tsx, SimulationModal.tsx, leaderboard.tsx, index.tsx.
(optional) Align @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to ^2.2.0 and react-native-svg to ^15.12.1 to match installed expo SDK to avoid native-build incompatibility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~365 lines (under 700 threshold) — fine. Excludes _id from Mongo reads properly. Uses async/await for all DB ops. Phase/lock + coin/bounds validations all return 400 with descriptive details.

Backend stores buildings as a denormalized array inside the player doc — acceptable for prototype, but consider extracting into its own collection if scale grows. Buildings array operations are O(n) per request — fine for n<=64 (8x8 grid).
Frontend correctly uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. testID present on all interactive elements. All text is wrapped in <Text>. Components use StyleSheet.create().
Note: prototype env variable is named EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL as in the env contract). Frontend code consistently uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL so this is consistent end-to-end.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_* player_ids and leaderboard entries created during pytest run. Not auto-cleaned (prototype DB). Safe to leave or wipe collections 'players' and 'leaderboard'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://festival-builder-2.preview.emergentagent.com (env var EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). For frontend e2e: clear localStorage before reload to start fresh player at 1500 coins. Speed up costs at minimum 10 coins. Default player_id auto-generated via AsyncStorage. build_time is real seconds, smallest 180s.
rca_of_issue: Grid tile tap bug RCA: IsometricGrid mapped touch handlers via onTouchEnd on a plain RN View. react-native-web only fires onTouchEnd for real Touch events. Mouse clicks (the default for web preview and Playwright .click()) never invoked onTilePress, blocking placement. Fix: use Pressable with onPress, which handles both pointer and touch on web AND tap on native. Verified post-fix that tile tap → drawer → place → timer → speedup → ready → simulate all work.
